'''Lofre Yinne''' was a [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] who was employed by [[Syndicate One]]'s front company, [[Executive Results]]. His starting salary was 3,200 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] per [[Standard month/Legends|month]].
